stardocs.moduleDocstring:
Extensions for bzlmod.

Exposes in repositories a Microsoft Windows SDK or a MSVC runtime headers and libraries.

attribute.name: architectures
attribute.docString: Architectures to extract from the resolved MSVC runtime components

attribute.name: msvc_version
attribute.docString: Required expected MSVC tools version. Only files under Contents/VC/Tools/MSVC/<msvc_version> are extracted.

attribute.name: installer_manifest_url
attribute.docString: URL of the resolved/specified Visual Studio installer manifest

attribute.name: installer_manifest_integrity
attribute.docString: Optional integrity of the resolved/specified Visual Studio installer manifest

attribute.name: installer_manifest_sha256
attribute.docString: Optional integrity (as sha256 hash) of the resolved/specified Visual Studio installer manifest

attribute.name: visual_studio_channel_url
attribute.docString: Visual Studio release channel URL used to resolve the installer manifest, use `visual_studio_installer_manifest_url` and `visual_studio_installer_manifest_integrity` for reproducibility instead

attribute.name: visual_studio_installer_manifest_url
attribute.docString: Override URL for the Visual Studio installer manifest, if set the installer manifest will not be resolved from a query to `visual_studio_channel_url`

attribute.name: visual_studio_installer_manifest_integrity
attribute.docString: Optional SRI integrity for the downloaded Visual Studio installer manifest.

moduleExtensionInfo.docString: Windows SDK extension backed by public NuGet packages.

attribute.name: architectures
attribute.docString: Architectures of the Windows SDK to download additionally to the base

attribute.name: windows_sdk_version
attribute.docString: Windows SDK NuGet package version, e.g. `10.0.26100.7705`

attribute.name: windows_sdk_integrity
attribute.docString: (optional) dict from Windows SDK NuGet package ID to integrity string

attribute.name: transformations
attribute.docString:
Dict of source path patterns to transformations applied when run on case-sensitive filesystems.

Supports exact paths and `**/*.ext` patterns. Use value `lowercase` to create lowercase aliases.

Example:
```
transformations = {
    "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/shared/driverspecs.h": "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/shared/DriverSpecs.h",
    "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/shared/specstrings.h": "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/shared/SpecStrings.h",
    "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/um/ole2.h": "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/um/Ole2.h",
    "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/um/olectl.h": "base/c/Include/10.0.26100.0/um/OleCtl.h",
    "**/*.h": "lowercase",
    "**/*.lib": "lowercase",
    "**/*.Lib": "lowercase",
}
```
